summary: Consume the whole historical shell-environment free list even when only one page remains after allocating the scrub table. The first zero row can fit its existing root leaf; a nonempty free list now receives at least two rows to force the root split.

rules.detail: Secure deletion, complete free-list consumption and successful checkpoints remain required before marking the scrub complete.

compatibility.detail: Existing completed scrub markers retain their skip behavior.

downtime.detail: Work remains bounded by the free list, with at most one additional zero row and no full startup VACUUM.

recovery.detail: Previously incomplete scrubs retry on the next open; checkpoint failures still refuse completion.
